annotations.title: WoW: Forever addons and open-source projects

description: Forever addons and tools from the community registry, with a board ranking: most installed, rising, most active, freshest release or best maintained. Each project shows its GitHub repository, stars, latest release, last commit, whether its .toc declares a Forever interface number, and installs from Everloot uploads (counted from 3 installs; a missing count means not counted, not zero). Projects are ranked, never people. GitHub facts carry the time they were refreshed.

board.description: installed, rising, active, release, maintained, or all (A to Z).

forever_ready_only.description: Only projects whose .toc lists a Forever interface number.

name: ecosystem_projects

connected.description: False when the tracker is not connected: the list is then not a measured zero.

forever.description: What Forever-ready compares each .toc with, derived from the build's version and not yet confirmed in the client.

installsAvailable.description: False when install counts could not be read: a null count then means unknown.

display.description: The board's own figure for this project, such as 6 installs.

installs.description: From Everloot uploads, counted from 3 installs; null means not counted, not zero.

rank.description: Position on the board; absent for the A to Z list.

refreshedAt.description: When the GitHub facts were last refreshed.

title: WoW: Forever addons and open-source projects
